records.title: Tuning Derivatives for Causal Fairness in Machine Learning
records.reason: The arXiv PDF develops path-specific derivative fairness definitions and predictor tuning for continuous protected attributes. It is a causal fairness method, unrelated to LLM inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: From Drops to Grid: Noise-Aware Spatio-Temporal Neural Process for Rainfall Estimation
records.reason: DropsToGrid is a neural-process method for rainfall densification from radar/station data. It targets weather-field prediction, not LLM inference.

records.title: Wisteria: A Unified Multi-Scale Feature Learning Framework for DNA Language Model
records.reason: Wisteria is a genomic/DNA language model for sequence analysis. Its tokenization and multi-scale feature work is for biological sequences, not natural-language LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Mean Mode Screaming: Mean-Variance Split Residuals for 1000-Layer Diffusion Transformers
records.reason: Mean-Variance Split Residuals addresses training collapse in very deep Diffusion Transformers and demonstrates stable training at extreme depth. It concerns diffusion-model training dynamics, not LLM inference.

records.title: Hidden States as Value Gradients: The Pontryagin Structure of Recurrent Policies
records.reason: This paper gives a control-theoretic interpretation of recurrent-policy hidden states and action readout. Its subject is recurrent reinforcement-learning policies, not language-model inference or serving.
